tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name, c.playlist_count
FROM (
  SELECT TrackId, COUNT(PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY TrackId
) c
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = c.TrackId
WHERE c.playlist_count = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(PlaylistId) AS cnt
    FROM PlaylistTrack
    GROUP BY TrackId
  )
)
ORDER BY t.TrackId;"}
